programmes.d: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

An armed robbery is a terrifying ordeal. When a gang descended on a Los Angeles cash vault, they threatened to kill anyone who resisted. The violent assault was the largest heist in U.S. history and a piece of plastic was the only evidence.
When a paramilitary faction used bombs and robbery to further their cause, they crossed the line. The well-organized terror cell was difficult to define, and even harder to stop.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programmes.d: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.
Oscar®-vinderen*, Charlize Theron, spiller Aeon Flux, som er en undergrundsagent, der kæmper mod det totalitære styre i Jordens sidste, levende by i det 25. århundrede.
Mændene fra Bravo Company står over for en kamp, hvor det er op ad bakke ... op ad Hamburger Hill.
Amys venner overrasker hende på hendes fødselsdag, men overraskelsen er over dem, da liget af Jacob Goodnight vender tilbage for at genoptage hans morderiske hærværk.

Paul Maguire (Nicolas Cage) lever et regelret liv efter en fortid som kriminel. Men hans fortid indhenter ham, da den russiske mafia kidnapper hans datter. Han tvinges til at genoptage de ulovlige metoder for at skaffe sin datter tilbage og få hævn.

Den stærke og stumme kriger, One Eye, er i årevis blevet holdt fanget af en høvding og hans klan. Men det lykkes for One Eye at flygte sammen med en slavedreng, og de slår sig sammen med nogle kristne vikinger på deres rejse mod Det hellige land. '

A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear
programmes.d: In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.
Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.

Over a thousand hunting accidents are reported in the United States each year. Fewer than ten percent of them are fatal. But when one hunter's death seemed suspicious, the FBI was called in to investigate.

A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.
